title: `bindings/node/package-lock.json` contained a link into a pnpm store path that no longer exists
what: Regenerated `package-lock.json` in bindings/node, adapters/vitest and mcp from a clean install after the lockfile contained a stale pnpm store path.
why: DECISIONS.md Linux container gate: `tsc` was missing in a clean install.
impact: Clean installs fail without regenerated lockfiles.
